Summary Files Reviews Support Code Svn Tickets ▾ Bugs Feature Requests News Discussion Donate Menu ▾ ▴ Create Ticket View Stats Group v1.0_(example) Searches Changes Closed Tickets Open Tickets Help Formatting Help #147 possibly a bug in org.joda.time.field.FieldUtils.safeMultipl Status: closed Owner: nobody Labels: Joda-Time (76) Priority: 5 Updated: 2012-10-08 Created: 2012-04-23 Creator: Colin Bartlett Private: No It seems to me that as currently written in joda-time-2.1.jar org.joda.time.field.FieldUtils.safeMultiply(long val1, int scalar) doesn't detect the overflow if the long val1 == Long.MIN_VALUE and the int scalar == -1. The attached file demonstrates what I think is the bug and suggests a patch. I looked at the Joda Time bugs list in SourceForge but couldn't see anything that looked relevant: my apologies if I've missed something, or if I'm making a mistake with this bug report. Colin Bartlett Discussion Colin Bartlett - 2012-04-23 demonstrates what I think may be a bug in org.joda.time.field.FieldUtils.safeMultiply(long, int) QJodaTimeSafeMultiply.java If you would like to refer to this comment somewhere else in this project, copy and paste the following link: Colin Bartlett - 2012-04-24 I've just noticed this in the release notes for 2.1 in http://joda-time.sourceforge.net/upgradeto210.html release notes and advice for upgrading Joda-Time from version 2.0 to version 2.1. ... Bug fixes since 2.0 ... Fix multiplication of Long.MIN_VALUE by -1 in safeMultiply() ... Looking at the source code in FieldUtils.java for 2.0 and 2.1 this seems to refer to fixing safeMultiply(long val1, long val2) but not safeMultiply(long val1, int scalar) ??
